children: aTyr Pharma announced FDA alignment on a global Phase 3 protocol for efzofitimod in pulmonary sarcoidosis and plans to start study activities in Q4 2026.
FDA agreed on protocol for a 54-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 of efzofitimod.
Study will enroll ~372 patients with restrictive pulmonary sarcoidosis, dosing 5.0 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for 17 doses.
Primary endpoint: change in FVC at week 48; key secondary: KSQ-Lung score change at week 48.
Company expects to begin study-related activities in Q4 2026 and will seek additional capital or partnerships to fund development.

title: aTyr Pharma aligns with FDA on Phase 3 efzofitimod study in pulmonary sarcoidosis
